opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, then save note
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search round-trip flights on Google Flights from Paris, search hotels on Booking, find a top activity on Viator, then write a summary trip note.
steps: Open Google Flights, set origin Paris, destination, select dates, Search, note cheapest flight
Open Booking, enter destination, select same dates, Search, open top hotel and note name/price
Open Viator, search for '<landmark> tour <city>', open top result, note title/price
Open Notes, create new note 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight ..., hotel ..., activity ...' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Web feature support lookup and reply email
opportunities.description: Look up browser support of a web feature on caniuse, find MDN docs page, then compose a reply email to a person with the version and docs link.
steps: Search the feature on caniuse and read supported version for the browser
Search the feature on MDN and open the doc page
Open mail compose, fill To, Subject 'Re: <feature> in <browser>', body with version and MDN link

opportunities.name: PyPI package comparison note
opportunities.description: Look up two Python packages on PyPI, open each repository for stars, and save a comparison note with version, date, stars and license.
steps: Search package on PyPI and open its page
Open Repository/Source link and record GitHub stars
Create note 'A version date stars license vs B ...'
